newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stock index down 1.13 pct near the close.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stock index down 1.13 pct near the close.

text.p: Jakarta composite index fell sharply near the close on Thursday due to worries over the volatile rupiah and reports of expected poor first half results of some big-capitalised firms, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index fell 8.11 points, or 1.13 percent, to 710.08 points shortly before the end of trading.
"Rupiah worries coupled with news reports that some big-capitalised firms are likely to report poor first half earnings prompted the heavy selling," one broker said.
